sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, p.birthday, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) >= 2013
AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) <= 2015
ORDER BY age
